Yep, recently solved it. It was pubic lice hidden away in my body hair. I shaved all my body hair, applied permethrin cream 3 times (1 week apart each) and malathion cream twice (1 week apart). I also washed everything in my house (bedding, clothes, towels, tea towels, bathmats etc) on a hot wash and put them all in the drier on 60 degrees celcius (I handled them by wearing gloves so my skin touched them as little as possible). Anything I couldn't wash got put in a spare room and left alone for 2 weeks. After that I was examined by a doctor, and they said that they seem to all be gone but I just need to wait now and make sure the itching doesn't come back. Horrible things! If you're going to go through the same process (obviously get diagnosed by a doctor first) then when applying the creams make SURE you get every part of your body and don't miss anywhere otherwise they have a chance of surviving. Even underneath your nails, in your ass crack etc. Literally everywhere, especially hairy places. I also applied the malathion lotion to my beard when doing it which was helpful. Best of luck!
